summary: 1–2, Elders are to continue to preach; 3–6, Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon are to continue to translate the Bible until it is finished.
meta_description: Revelation given to Joseph Smith the Prophet and Sidney Rigdon, at Hiram, Ohio, January 10, 1832. Since the early part of the preceding December, the Prophet and Sidney had been engaged in preaching, and by this means much was accomplished in diminishing the unfavorable feelings that had arisen against the Church (see the heading to section 71).

footnotes.note1_a: IE the others who were on missions; see D&C 57–68.
footnotes.note3_b: IE the translation of the Bible. D&C 45:60 (60–61); 76:15.
